players.product: KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) anti-PD-1 therapy; intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157), jointly developed with Moderna

quarterly_data.quarter: Merck & Co. press release: Merck Inaugurates State-of-the-Art ADVANCE Bioanalytical (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Merck inaugurated its ADVANCE research facility on its West Point, Pennsylvania campus, which uses highly automated robotic systems and digital AI capabilities to analyze biological samples from its clinical development programs. As part of its previously announced $70 billion commitment to domestic manufacturing and R&D, Merck is investing approximately $550 million in R&D facilities at ADVANCE and the nearby Spring House Innovation Park (SHIP); capital investment at the 400-acre West Point site, its largest integrated research and human health manufacturing site, totals more than $15 billion over the past 35 years. CEO Rob Davis: ADVANCE represents the future of clinical development at Merck.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately $550 million (ADVANCE and SHIP); part of a $70 billion U.S. commitment
